description: Canonical source record for the Solutions section's page content. WordPress is the runtime editor; these files are the recoverable source. Not loaded by WordPress. Block markup in each source file is exactly what the block editor stores in post_content. Entries without a source set page fields only (the one-line summaries the Solutions overview reads).

meta.summit_standfirst: Summit works across strategy, brand, editorial, experience, digital commerce, product, IP and patrimony. The route in depends on the industry, the function or the question that needs resolving.

meta.summit_headline: Read the maison before the transaction.
meta.summit_standfirst: Maison Due Diligence examines the institutional, brand, patrimonial and governance conditions that shape a luxury house beyond price.
meta.summit_summary: Read the institutional, brand, patrimonial and governance conditions behind the transaction.
Define the position before deciding how to express it.
Decide how desire is created, sustained and withheld.
Determine what is worth saying, create something worth reading, and place it before people worth reaching.
Give every point of contact the same discipline as the object at its centre.
Sell online without abandoning the scarcity, service and presentation that define the house.
Judge which objects carry the house, and secure what makes them its own.
Create the institutional architecture required to become more than a brand.
Move the standing of a house without severing what made it.
Grow demand while protecting the scarcity and meaning that create it.
Protect the authority of what the house is known for without allowing repetition to become inertia.
Turn archive, marks and know-how into living authority rather than heritage theatre.
Make every encounter with the house worthy of its objects.
Earn an authoritative voice in the conversations that shape the category.
Use intelligent systems where they deepen judgement, not where they cheapen it.
Bring luxury judgement to decisions about capital, holdings and growth.
